modules.name: API Security & Schema Assessment
modules.description: REST, GraphQL, and OpenAPI schema security evaluation, endpoint fuzzing, broken object level authorization (BOLA) tests, and rate limit analysis.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Authorization & Multi-Role API Testing
modules.description: Automated BOLA (Broken Object Level Authorization) and BFLA (Broken Function Level Authorization) verification across isolated user roles, tenant boundaries, and privilege levels.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

test_bola.description: Test Broken Object Level Authorization across role tokens

test_bfla.description: Test Broken Function Level Authorization against admin/privileged routes

test_unauthenticated.description: Test unauthenticated access to protected API resources

modules.name: Authenticated Web Crawler & Session Manager
modules.description: Consent-scoped web crawler and session manager. Traverses web endpoints, extracts forms, detects hidden administrative interfaces, and enforces domain boundaries.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl

extract_forms.description: Extract forms and parameters for DAST scanning

modules.name: CAN Bus & Automotive Vehicle Security
modules.description: Automotive Controller Area Network (CAN) security assessment: audits standard 11-bit and extended 29-bit CAN IDs, detects frame spoofing, denial-of-service bus flooding (ID 0x000), diagnostic OBD-II / UDS service exposures, and unauthorized actuator overrides.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Security Posture Auditor
modules.description: Evaluates Terraform (HCL/JSON), Kubernetes manifests (YAML), and CloudFormation templates against CIS Cloud Benchmarks to detect public S3 buckets, permissive security groups (0.0.0.0/0 on sensitive ports), unencrypted disks/databases, and root/privileged containers.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Cloud IAM & Excessive Privilege Auditor
modules.description: Multi-cloud identity & access management security auditor for AWS, GCP, and Azure. Detects wildcard policies (*:*), public cloud storage buckets, dangerous role assumption (sts:AssumeRole), and privilege escalation paths.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

audit_wildcard_permissions.description: Detect overly permissive full administrative wildcard policies

audit_public_access.description: Detect public storage buckets and unauthenticated cloud resource access

audit_trust_policies.description: Analyze cross-account and external entity role trust boundaries

modules.name: Container & Dockerfile Security Inspector
modules.description: Static Dockerfile and container configuration auditing: detects root user execution, dangerous capabilities (CAP_SYS_ADMIN), unpinned base images, sensitive socket mounting (/var/run/docker.sock), and CIS Docker Benchmark violations.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Cookie Security & Session Hygiene Inspector
modules.description: Audits session tokens and HTTP cookies: checks for missing Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite (Strict/Lax/None) flags, validates modern __Host- and __Secure- cookie prefixes, and calculates session ID entropy to detect predictable tokens.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: CORS & WebSocket Security Auditor
modules.description: Audits Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) policies against dangerous misconfigurations (reflected origin with credentials, null origin trust, wildcard leaks) and inspects WebSocket upgrade handshakes against Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking (CSWSH).
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Secrets & Credential Vault Engine
modules.description: Encrypted credential vault, token hygiene auditor, expiration tracker, and automated rotation advisor for assessment sessions.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

audit_expiry_days.description: Flag credentials older than this threshold in days

enforce_encryption_at_rest.description: Validate that stored secrets use AES-GCM encryption at rest

modules.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) & Header Auditor
modules.description: Deeply audits Content Security Policy (CSP Level 3) directives (script-src, object-src, unsafe-inline, unsafe-eval, nonce/hash validation, frame-ancestors for Clickjacking defense), HSTS preloading, COOP, COEP, and Permissions-Policy.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: DAST Evidence Verifier & Reproduction Engine
modules.description: Dynamic application security verification engine. Confirms suspected vulnerabilities through safe, non-destructive reproduction probes and assigns strict confidence labels.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

non_destructive_only.description: Enforce strictly read-only and non-destructive reproduction probes

modules.name: Digital Forensics & Malware Triage
modules.description: Cryptographic file hashing (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256), binary Shannon entropy calculation for packed malware detection, suspicious string extraction, and immutable chain-of-custody logging.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Docker Daemon & Container Runtime Hardening Inspector
modules.description: CIS Docker Benchmark daemon and container runtime evaluator. Audits daemon.json hardening, unencrypted TCP daemon exposures, rootless mode, userns-remap, default seccomp profiles, and runtime capability drops.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

audit_daemon_json.description: Evaluate /etc/docker/daemon.json configuration for CIS benchmark compliance

audit_tcp_socket.description: Verify that Docker TCP socket enforces TLS mutual authentication (tlsverify)

require_userns_remap.description: Check whether user namespace remapping is enabled to prevent container root from matching host root

modules.name: Email Security & Anti-Spoofing Auditor
modules.description: Audits domain email security posture including SPF, DMARC policies (p=reject vs none), DKIM DNS alignments, BIMI, MTA-STS, and parses raw .eml emails for spoofing, anomalous hops, and suspicious Authentication-Results.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: GitHub Actions & CI/CD Security Audit
modules.description: OWASP CI/CD Top 10 scanner and Wiz Code best-practice auditor: detects script injections in workflow run steps, unpinned third-party actions, overprivileged tokens (write-all), dangerous pull_request_target triggers, and secret leaks.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: GraphQL Schema & Query Depth Auditor
modules.description: Audits GraphQL APIs against common security weaknesses: enabled production Introspection (__schema), circular query depth Denial of Service, batching query amplification, field suggestion leaks, and missing complexity limiters.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Hashira AI Defensive Security Assistant
modules.description: AI-powered defensive security workstation assistant: automated findings triage, CVE/CWE explanations, remediation code patching, secret redaction, and bilingual security report drafting (EN & FA).
modules.author: Cyber Hashira AI Labs

modules.name: Host & Endpoint Security Posture Inspector
modules.description: Multi-platform host security baseline evaluator for Windows and Linux. Audits Defender/EDR status, firewall profiles, BitLocker encryption, SSH daemon hardening, systemd root services, and kernel controls.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

audit_firewall.description: Audit host firewall active state across all profiles

audit_encryption.description: Verify volume encryption (BitLocker / LUKS) on system volumes

audit_ssh_hardening.description: Audit sshd_config parameters for root login and password authentication

modules.name: Active Directory & Identity Hygiene Auditor
modules.description: Evaluates Active Directory and enterprise identity configurations against CIS Benchmarks, auditing stale accounts, accounts with non-expiring passwords, Kerberos pre-authentication bypass risk, SMBv1/NTLMv1 exposure, and over-privileged Domain Admin group memberships.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: JWT & Cryptographic Token Analyzer
modules.description: Audits JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for critical security flaws: 'alg: none' signature bypass, weak HMAC secrets, RSA-to-HMAC algorithm confusion (CVE-2015-9235), expired tokens with invalid exp/nbf handling, and unvalidated 'kid' header parameter injections.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Kubernetes Security Posture & RBAC Auditor
modules.description: Comprehensive Kubernetes posture assessment: evaluates Pod Security Standards (PSS), dangerous RBAC wildcard bindings, hostPID/hostNetwork escapes, privileged containers, missing network policies, and hostPath mounts.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

audit_rbac.description: Audit ClusterRoles and RoleBindings for wildcard/escalation privileges

enforce_pss_restricted.description: Check workloads against Kubernetes Restricted Pod Security Standard

audit_network_policies.description: Verify presence of default-deny NetworkPolicies in active namespaces

modules.name: Network Forensics & PCAP Credential Extractor
modules.description: Deep packet inspection and network capture forensic analysis (inspired by BruteShark): parses PCAP files, reconstructs network sessions, extracts cleartext passwords (HTTP, FTP, Telnet, IMAP), and recovers Kerberos / NTLM challenge-response authentication hashes.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Network & Port Discovery (Nmap Core)
modules.description: Authorized network reconnaissance, port scanning, service version detection, and topology mapping with native Nmap integration and fallback engine.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: DNS & Domain Reconnaissance
modules.description: Performs DNS record inspection, MX discovery, SPF/DMARC validation, and domain reconnaissance on authorized targets.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Static Application Security Testing (SAST) Scanner
modules.description: Scans application source code (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP, Go) for dangerous source-to-sink vulnerability patterns: SQL injection string concatenation, command injection (eval, exec, system, shell=True), path traversal, and insecure deserialization (pickle, yaml.load).
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Software Bill of Materials & Dependency Auditor
modules.description: Generates and inspects CycloneDX / SPDX Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), evaluates manifest files (package.json, requirements.txt, go.mod, Cargo.toml), matches known vulnerable components (CVEs) and warns against risky open-source licenses.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Secrets, API Keys & PII Leak Scanner
modules.description: Analyzes source code, configuration files, and git commit diffs to discover inadvertently committed credentials, AWS/GCP/Azure access keys, private keys (RSA/SSH), OpenAI/Stripe/GitHub tokens, and sensitive PII using high-entropy calculation and regex signature matching.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: MITRE Sensor Mappings & Detection Coverage Auditor
modules.description: Based on MITRE Center for Threat-Informed Defense (CTID) Sensor Mappings to ATT&CK (SMAP): evaluates telemetry sensor coverage (Sysmon, Windows Event Logs, Linux Auditd, Zeek, Suricata, eBPF) against ATT&CK data sources and adversary TTPs, identifying blind spots in defensive detection pipelines.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Sigma & YARA Threat Hunting Rule Engine
modules.description: Validates and executes Sigma detection rules and YARA signatures against system event logs (Windows Security, Sysmon, Linux Auditd) and suspicious artifacts, identifying threat indicators and translating Sigma rules into SIEM queries (Splunk, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch).
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: SSRF & Cloud Metadata Defense Validator
modules.description: Audits URLs, webhooks, and outbound request endpoints against Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) and metadata theft, detecting private RFC 1918 ranges, AWS/GCP/Azure instance metadata endpoints, IPv6 bypasses, and decimal/octal IP obfuscation.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Subdomain Takeover & Dangling DNS Auditor
modules.description: Scans DNS records and CNAME aliases to discover dangling pointers to deleted or deprovisioned cloud services (AWS S3, GitHub Pages, Heroku, Azure Traffic Manager, Zendesk, Fastly, Shopify) where attackers could hijack the subdomain.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Threat Intelligence & MITRE ATT&CK Engine
modules.description: IOC enrichment (IP, domain, hash), MITRE ATT&CK technique mapping, threat correlation, and offline intelligence caching.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: TLS & Cryptography Inspector
modules.description: TLS certificate chain validation, expiration auditing, weak cipher suite discovery (RC4, 3DES, CBC), TLS 1.0/1.1 deprecation checks, and cryptographic security scoring.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Vulnerability Assessment (Nuclei Core)
modules.description: Rule-based vulnerability scanner and template evaluation engine mapping CVEs, CWEs, and CVSS scores with false-positive reduction.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: WAF & Normalization Defense Validator
modules.description: Audits Web Application Firewall (WAF) rule efficacy and input normalization defenses against evasion vectors: Unicode overlong encoding, HTTP parameter pollution (HPP), path traversal normalization discrepancies, and chunked transfer smuggling flags.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Web Application Security Suite
modules.description: Burp & ZAP inspired web security workspace: HTTP/HTTPS proxy engine, Repeater, Decoder/Encoder, HTTP history, and automated passive vulnerability analysis.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

modules.name: Wireless & 802.11 WiFi Security Auditor
modules.description: 802.11 wireless network auditing: analyzes WEP, WPA, WPA2-PSK (TKIP/CCMP), and WPA3-SAE security postures, detects WPS PIN vulnerability risks, PMKID exposure, rogue APs, and weak pre-shared keys.
modules.author: Cyber Hashira Security Team
